_about: Where gathering goes (scripts/camp/camp_projects.gd). The sell crate (crate.model in data/clearing.json): a player within reach_m puts in their first stack with a price, one stack a press, keeping back as many as the open camp project still needs (none to spare: deny.project_needs_it), and with nothing to sell takes the last stack back; at night it pays prices (coins each, flat and low: guests stay the main income) in the morning report and the clipboard counts everything shipped. Items with no price (saplings) stay out. Camp projects, filled at the project board (board_model) in this order, one open at a time: needs are items or item kinds (data/items.json) with counts, brought from either player's Pack and then the camp box. A finished project pays coins and opens any workbench recipe that names it (data/craft.json project). Names: data/text.json project.<id>.
